text: Can you pull together every ticket number on Quarrendon Freight Lines you can find across Moss's notes? List each with where it comes from. Putting it in the weekly notes.
reply_text:
I replied to Dana in your DM. I found two Quarrendon Freight Lines ticket numbers in Moss's notes:

- **#4419**, from Moss's undated North cheat sheet (`teams/team-north/digests/north-account-cheatsheet.md`). Gatehouse barcode scanners weren't reading trailer tags at Door 14 on third shift. The note says it was escalated to tier-2 support for scanner firmware testing.
- **#PD-4492**, from Moss's 5 Oct 2025 "Sunday prep for Ruth" digest (`teams/team-north/digests/2025-10-05-north-sunday.md`). Drivers at Eau Claire Dock Doors 14–18 weren't getting SMS bay assignments when they checked in at the kiosk. Support patched it on 4 Oct 2025.

Moss's other two North digests mention Quarrendon but give no ticket numbers. The Central digests don't mention Quarrendon at all.

I also told Dana about a conflict. Marcus's 14 Jul 2025 note, which isn't one of Moss's, lists the same #4419 for Quarrendon but calls it Gate 3 printer lag. One of the two descriptions is probably wrong, so Dana should check it against the ticket itself before it goes in the weekly notes.

I only used Moss's digests that are public in the shared files, which Dana can read. I left out chat channels and anything private.
